add_items_to_list.title: Open-hardware turbidity sensor with biofouling compensation
add_items_to_list.details: A self-cleaning optical path and drift-correction method for long-term deployment in coastal and estuarine waters. Patent NO 348 219 B1.

add_items_to_list.title: Chitin-based biodegradable film and method of manufacture
add_items_to_list.details: A solvent-free route to flexible chitin films whose degradation rate is set by acetylation degree rather than additives. Application EP 4 512 887 A1.

add_items_to_list.title: Passive aerosol sampler with size-selective inlet
add_items_to_list.details: A low-power sampler that separates coarse and fine particulate fractions for isotopic source apportionment. Patent NO 341 706 B1.
